meta.analysis: D04 frozen OOF county-event net-increment diagnostics
meta.units: hourly fraction differences; 0.01 is 1 percentage point
meta.weight: one existing clipped design weight meta.w per county-event
meta.weighted_quantile_method: inverse empirical weighted CDF; first cumulative mass >= probability
meta.peak_definition: max(max(net increments on valid adjacent observed hours), 0)
meta.peak_time: earliest exact positive maximum; no-positive or unsupported has no peak time
meta.positive_sum: sum of positive one-hour net increments on retained support
meta.negative_sum: signed sum of negative one-hour net increments on retained support
meta.all_zero_group: at least one observed stock hour, and every observed stock in all 216 hours equals zero
meta.boundary_flag: any exact positive peak at forecast target time 72 or 215
meta.support_boundary_flag: any exact positive peak at first or last valid target hour
meta.adjacent_missing_flag: a neighboring increment within 72..215 unavailable because its stock endpoint is missing
meta.plateau_flag: at least two consecutive target hours tied at the exact positive maximum
meta.time_lag_support: both observed and predicted peaks positive; boundary/tie/missing flags never excluded
meta.interpretation: net-change diagnostics, not physical impact rates, stock burden, or autonomous trajectory forecasts
meta.threshold_comparison_limit: the 1pp increment threshold differs from any previous stock-peak case threshold; counts are not comparable
